description: Move conversations from one team member to another in one step — e.g. "move Ahmed's waiting chats to Mona". By default only the conversations awaiting a reply (the customer wrote last) move; use scope=all for every open conversation the member holds, or waiting_longer_than_minutes for only the late ones. The giver is removed, the receiver is assigned and notified, and the change is recorded in the conversation history. Get member ids from get_moderators or get_agent_performance.

confirm.description: Consent gate — REQUIRED on every call. Pass false first: the tool then performs no action and returns a preview of exactly what would happen. Show that preview to the user, get their explicit approval, and only then call again with true to move the conversations.

from_user_id.description: Team member whose conversations move away.

limit.description: Most conversations to move in this call, oldest wait first. Default 200, max 500.

scope.description: awaiting_reply (default): only conversations where the customer is waiting for an answer. all: every non-archived conversation assigned to from_user_id.

waiting_longer_than_minutes.description: Only conversations whose customer has been waiting at least this many minutes (implies awaiting_reply). E.g. 60 = waiting an hour or more.

name: reassign_conversations
